name: Ecamm Live
description: Ecamm Live is a macOS live-streaming, recording, remote-interview, multistream production, and video-presentation application. Creators and teams use it to compose scenes, control cameras and overlays, manage guests and comments, broadcast to multiple destinations, and retain local recordings.
agentUseSummary: Ecamm Live cannot yet be controlled through Relay. Ecamm documents user-approved third-party local control and a broad Stream Deck action surface, but publishes no remote-control protocol, SDK, transport, authentication handshake, state schema, version contract, or redistribution terms that Relay can implement safely.

blocked.label: Connect Ecamm Live
blocked.description: Ecamm publishes no remote-control SDK, transport, request and response schema, authentication handshake, versioning, lifecycle, or error contract for Relay.

blocked.label: Read private Ecamm state
blocked.description: Profiles, scenes, overlays, cameras, microphones, destinations, broadcasts, guests, comments, viewer counts, recordings, files, and application state remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Operate broadcasts or recordings
blocked.description: Creating, scheduling, configuring, starting, pausing, publishing, stopping, ending, duplicating, or deleting broadcasts and recordings is blocked.

blocked.label: Control live production
blocked.description: Switching scenes, profiles, cameras, screenshares, guests, overlays, animations, audio, video, PDF pages, preview mode, picture-in-picture, effects, markers, or application controls is blocked.

blocked.label: Communicate or distribute content
blocked.description: Posting comments, promoting viewer content, accepting guests, sending streams to destinations, uploading media, publishing announcement posts, and exporting or sharing recordings is blocked.

blocked.label: Handle streaming or downstream secrets
blocked.description: RTMP stream keys, destination logins and passwords, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Zoom, Amazon, Restream and other downstream tokens, session data, and guest links never enter Relay agent inputs or results.

blocked.label: Control the Mac or local files
blocked.description: Launching or quitting Ecamm, controlling other applications or devices, changing macOS permissions, reading or writing recordings, choosing arbitrary Finder files, and controlling cameras, microphones, displays, NDI, or virtual devices is blocked.

blocked.label: Use private Ecamm interfaces
blocked.description: Reverse engineering bundled plugins, replaying Stream Deck traffic, scraping app state, UI automation, Accessibility injection, Apple Events without a published contract, private sockets, undocumented protocols, and raw command or event access are blocked.

blocked.label: Administer Ecamm
blocked.description: Account, team, seat, role, subscription, billing, plan, license, update, profile, destination, social-network, device, and privacy administration is blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Ecamm Live action is enabled until Ecamm supplies a documented local-control contract and Relay freezes device-local authority, user approval, production safety, downstream platform, content, guest, privacy, file, and recovery boundaries.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are mounted because Ecamm is a user-approved local Mac authority and its remote-control protocol is not publicly documented.
No Hermes tools are mounted because Ecamm is a user-approved local Mac authority and its remote-control protocol is not publicly documented.

providerSetup.blocker: Ecamm Live is a paid local macOS application with explicit per-application Remote Control permission and an extensive bundled Stream Deck action surface. Ecamm does not publish the underlying protocol, SDK, transport, discovery, authentication handshake, permission identity, state and event schemas, version negotiation, timeouts, idempotency, concurrency, error model, revocation, or redistribution contract needed for a Relay integration. The available actions can immediately start or finish broadcasts, publish preview changes, accept interview guests, post comments, switch profiles and production sources, play local media, write recording and marker files, and exercise downstream social-network authority stored on the Mac. Cloud execution would also cross Relay's device-local authority boundary.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, local-runtime, macOS security, live-production, content, distribution, privacy, legal, and customer owners must obtain Ecamm's current remote-control SDK and written redistribution terms. Freeze a strictly local, user-initiated connection; exact Ecamm process and version binding; per-app permission and revocation; discovery and transport; read-only state; destination and profile binding; Safe approvals for every live, recording, guest, comment, media, file, and publication action; Dangerous behavior; downstream token isolation; crash and reconnect behavior; idempotency; rollback; audit; and post-disconnect denial. Only then may Relay implement and verify typed local wrappers.

evidence.supports: Ecamm presents Ecamm Live as a Mac production application for live streaming, recording, interviews, scenes, overlays, cameras, comments, and multistream distribution.
Ecamm documents explicit per-application Remote Control permission for Stream Deck and other third-party local apps, but publishes no technical protocol on the page.
Ecamm documents a broad bundled Stream Deck surface spanning live and recording lifecycle, scenes, overlays, media, cameras, audio, comments, guests, profiles, files, and viewer state.

Ecamm documents destination account linking, secret RTMP keys and optional passwords, up to ten destinations, scheduling and publishing, downstream privacy, live start, and broadcast deletion as interactive local workflows.

Ecamm documents live viewer and comment data, stopping and ending semantics, local recording and marker files, post deletion, and external media exports, establishing the high-impact production and privacy boundary.
Ecamm's terms govern paid software and subscriptions through a personal, non-transferable license and defer to any product-specific EULA.

Ecamm's privacy policy documents locally stored downstream access tokens and processing of social profiles, scheduled streams, comments, reactions, viewers, Zoom meetings, participants, audio, and video.
